summary: A regulatory and capital markets day, with Sebi approving major framework changes for accredited investors and portfolio managers, while Reliance pursues $1 billion in bond fundraising.

bullets.text: Sebi widened accredited investors definition by introducing new asset criteria for individuals and corporates.
Sebi approved PRIM route allowing portfolio managers to invest client money in mutual funds, ETFs, index funds and SIFs with Rs 25 lakh minimum ticket.
Reliance Industries planning up to $1 billion fundraise through local currency bonds, second bond issuance within weeks.
Amazon announces $3 billion investment in India's quick commerce business by 2030.
India's consumer durables market expected to grow 8-10% annually, reaching Rs 3-3.25 lakh crore by 2030, with Rs 50,000 crore localisation opportunity.
